i.norm:
Verifies that a subclass can override {@code tokenize()} to substitute a completely different char array, offset, and count from what was originally passed to the constructor.

"w x y z".toCharArray(), offset=2, count=5 covers the sub-range "x y z", whose space-delimited tokens are "x", "y", "z" — regardless of the constructor argument "a b c d e".
